description: 36 step-by-step expert workflows for the export jobs around the data — what exporters usually learn too late: export readiness check (blind spots, 90-day plan), certification and registration in each market (FDA, MoCRA, CPNP, NMPA, halal, CE, PSE …) and in whose name, labels, HS code, regulation watch, export control and sanctions screening, FTA origin and certificates of origin, export documents (PI, CI, packing list, L/C), logistics, Incoterms, samples and dangerous goods, pricing and quotes, payment terms, L/C and export credit insurance, duty drawback and zero-rated VAT, Korean export support programs (vouchers, certification and trade-show subsidies) and grant applications, buyer due diligence and fraud checks (changed bank details), trademarks, distribution agreements, claims and unpaid invoices, trade shows, buyer outreach, reply triage, sales kits, influencer seeding, marketplaces, cross-border e-commerce and creative. Call with job (what the user asked, in their words and language) to get the best-matching workflow in full plus the next matches; with name for a known one; with neither to list them all by stage. Follow the steps in order: each names the TradeGraph tools to call (gtm_plan, blind_spots, price_ladder …) and the official sources to check. The same text as TradeGraph's Agent Skills and Claude Code plugin. Free, read-only.

file.description: Optional, with name: a reference file the workflow mentions, e.g. 'references/sources.md'.

job.description: What the user wants done, in their own words and any language (e.g. '이 바이어 믿어도 돼? 입금 계좌가 바뀌었대', 'the US buyer wants an FTA certificate of origin', 'first export, what are we missing?'). Returns the best-matching workflow.

name.description: A workflow name (from the list, or a name a TradeGraph answer mentions such as certification-check).

name: export_workflow
title: Step-by-step export workflows (certification, FTA origin, documents, payment, buyer checks …)
